lifetime: At most four callbacks per search(), only first root family branch; local diagnostic flags are not semantic state or checkpoint metadata. No callbacks for later root siblings/branches. Child callback only if matching root placement and its original observer post-tick returned.
payload_types: Builtin JSON dict/list/str/int/bool/None; own fields are fresh wrappers, references point only to already-owned literal plans/state/census/individual events. No tuple/frozenset/function/private int-key map/live events list. No deep copy/hash/traversal/model call is introduced by packet construction.

record_semantics.FIRST_CHILD_DECISION_READY: After first decision returned at depth1 beneath this root placement, before classifying or acting on the decision. Actual individual DECISION event owns statuses/evidence; no private int-key certificate dictionary.
record_semantics.FIRST_ROOT_FAMILY_EVENT_READY: After unchanged _adopt_family_branch returns; individual full FAMILY_PREFERENCE event. No placement yet.
record_semantics.FIRST_ROOT_FAMILY_PLAN_READY: Only first completed depth0 family selection; actual global DECISION event retained before selection delegate, since selection can emit fallback events. plan.mode explicitly distinguishes BATCH/CONTINUATION READY preference from CANONICAL_FALLBACK.
record_semantics.FIRST_ROOT_PRIMITIVE_PLACED: After unchanged place returns; exact installed COW state, transition and individual preceding INVALIDATE/PLACE events; no child decision yet.

required_observer: Authenticated synchronous read-only milestone_observer(stage,payload), positional. Return ignored; native/Source/other errors are not masked.
